diagnosis.overview: The agent systematically fails to ground its work in the actual source file contents, instead operating on hallucinated data, default sheet names, or incomplete read results — caused by a lack of a dedicated, reliable spreadsheet-reading tool and a habit of skipping or failing file inspection.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent systematically fails to ground its work in the actual source file contents, instead operating on hallucinated data, default sheet names, or incomplete read results — caused by a lack of a dedicated, reliable spreadsheet-reading tool and a habit of skipping or failing file inspection.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Wire in a dedicated spreadsheet-inspection tool (e.g., `read_workbook`) that returns all sheet names, dimensions, and raw cell values in a structured form, and enforce a mandatory first-step call to this tool for any spreadsheet task. 2) Add a prompt rule requiring the agent to quote actual retrieved values and verify that output shape, sheet names, and data types match the task’s explicit constraints (range, sheet name, numeric vs. string) before finalizing.
